project_type: FileForgeWorkbench (FFWB) -- a Rust Cargo workspace; egui/eframe desktop app (crates/ff-desktop) plus many model/support crates (ff-i18n, ff-help, ff-config, etc.)
build_system: Cargo workspace. Owner runs a full completion gate via `cargo gate --build` (fmt + clippy + build + nextest + app-build). Agents run SCOPED cargo commands per crate.
test_framework: Rust built-in #[cfg(test)] unit tests + egui_kittest for GUI/focus behaviour; owner's gate uses cargo-nextest. Agents use plain `cargo test -p <crate>`.
verification_instructions: Per terminal-discipline.md: run every command through the clean pwsh7 wrapper `C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "<cmd> *> tools\logs\<name>.log"`, then READ the log file with the read tool to establish pass/fail -- do NOT trust the reported Exit Code (a spurious -1 is common). Confirm results by effect (a produced file, the log contents), never by the exit line. One command per invocation; never ';'-chain. Prefer the read/grep/glob tools over shell for inspection.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None for this slice. The shipped English catalogue lives under crates/ff-i18n/i18n/en/ as DATA .ftl files (hand-authored, not generated).
environment_constraints: Work ONLY inside the worktree c:\workspace\apps\FileForgeWorkbench\.worktrees\l10n-phase2-slice1 -- a RELATIVE path lands in the parent workspace. Use `git -C <that absolute worktree path>` for all git. Commit locally on the branch; NEVER push. tools/logs/ is git-ignored and ephemeral; create it if missing. ASCII-only in all docs and pattern-matched source (documentation-charset.md).
contribution_requirements: Requirements gate is CLOSED -- this is code-mode against approved criteria in docs/specs/localization/requirements.md; author NO new requirements. TDD is mandatory (testing.md): write the failing test FIRST with a `// Validates: Requirement X.Y` annotation, named by behaviour, deterministic. Build ON existing seams only; add NO new mechanism (Req 10.1). Behaviour-neutral at ui.locale=en (Req 10.2) -- existing egui_kittest focus/behaviour tests MUST stay green. rust-standards.md: no source .rs file over 400 non-test lines (split per the _state/_render/_commands/_dialogs/_tests order); functions <= ~40 lines; no unwrap/expect in non-test code.
key_patterns: ff-i18n seam: `ff_i18n::t(key) -> String` resolves active locale -> English Identity_Base -> the KEY string (plus WARN) on total miss. `set_catalogue(Catalogue)` installs/swaps the process-wide active catalogue; `Catalogue::load_identity_base(i18n_root)` loads crates/ff-i18n/i18n/en/*.ftl. CRITICAL: set_catalogue has NO production caller yet -- FEAT-001 adds the first one. Config: ui.locale key already registered (ff_config::keys::ui::LOCALE, default "en"); ff_config::on_locale_reload(callbacks, action) registers the hot-reload callback on ui.locale (action is workbench-supplied). Help loader: ContentLoader resolves the first existing dir from an ordered search_paths list, discovers .help.md recursively; Topic_Key comes from parsed content not the path. Menus: built-in content is code-only TOML constants in menu_workspace/defaults.rs (DEFAULT_POM_TOML, DEFAULT_SETTINGS_TOML) -- NEVER write translated TOML to disk; localise at render time out of the parsed MenuFile.
relevant_files: docs/specs/localization/tasks.md (tick task 4 parent; items are tasks 4,5,6)
crates/ff-i18n/i18n/en/main.ftl (existing English keys -- pattern to follow; add menus.ftl beside it)
crates/ff-desktop/src/main.rs (startup: step 2a schema reg -> call catalogue bootstrap before shell build)

directory_structure: crates/ff-i18n: GUI-free catalogue mechanism + lookup seam (src/ + i18n/en/ DATA). crates/ff-help: help content loader + topic model. crates/ff-config: schema registry, hot-reload callbacks, ui.locale key. crates/ff-desktop: the egui shell -- src/main.rs entry, src/shell/ (construct.rs, mod_helpers.rs, environment.rs, alias_overlay.rs, i18n_bootstrap.rs to be added), src/menu_workspace/ (mod.rs model, defaults.rs code-only TOML, render.rs, i18n_keys.rs to be added). docs/specs/localization/ holds the approved requirements + tasks. tools/logs/ is the git-ignored log sink for the read-back verification discipline.
